title: NileCart Sales (Zero Grad)
subtitle: A fictional online shop in Cairo: orders, customers, products, EGP
description: Synthetic teaching data for the Zero Grad Data Analysis course. NileCart is a fictional online shop in Cairo that delivers across Egypt (prices in EGP). `sales.csv` is the clean, enriched order-line table. `orders`, `customers`, `products`, `governorates` and `fx_rates` are the raw tables, with planted data-quality problems for cleaning practice. Generated by build/make_orders_data.py (seed 42).
